title: 국회상임위원회 위원 정수에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00214:20180716:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <National Assembly Regulation No. 214, July 16, 2018>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Regulations shall enter into force on the date on which they are adopted by the National Assembly: Provided, That the amended provisions of subparagraphs 5 and 10 shall enter into force on the enforcement date of Act No. 15713, the Act Partially Amending the National Assembly Act.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning the Education, Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee)
The Education, Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee under the former provisions as at the time these Regulations enter into force shall be deemed to exist separately until the amended provisions of subparagraphs 5 and 10 enter into force.
